newsitem.title: USA: U.S. retail stocks strong on July sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. retail stocks strong on July sales.

text.p: Retail stocks rose Tuesday as sales at many large chains increased during the month of July, improving chances the industry will post healthy earnings gains for the second quarter, analysts said.

The shares of Dayton Hudson Corp, Federated Department Stores Inc and others were higher because business have been strong this month, analysts said. In addition, markdowns have not been unusually steep and widespread, aside from the normal summer clearance sales.

"Clearance has been progressing well," said Richard Church of Smith Barney. "The earnings for the second quarter look like they will come in on target or slightly above" Wall Street's current estimates.

The retail industry closes its books on the second quarter at the end of July and will report earnings in early August. Analysts could raise earnings estimates after reviewing same-store sales results for July, which will be released August 7.
"I will be adjusting my estimates," Church said.
